headline: the differential's own parser OVERWRITES the source of any damage event that kills, replacing psn / leechseed / sandstorm with the bare literal 'capped_lethal'. Showdown's attribution is discarded, the engine's is kept, and the two then cannot agree. This is a harness defect, and the file already contains the correct pattern eight lines above it.
status: CAUSE ESTABLISHED AT SOURCE. Fix NOT implemented. Closes the class reports/c103 found and could not attribute.

the_code.what_it_does: `if fainted_here and tag == "-damage": source = "capped_lethal"` -- an unconditional assignment that DISCARDS whatever `[from]` source Showdown supplied.
the_code.the_correct_pattern_is_eight_lines_above: the capped-HEAL branch does the same job without the damage: `source = f"{source}_to_full"`, and its own comment says why -- 'The tag is PRESERVED so attribution is still compared; only the magnitude is relaxed, and only in the capped direction.' The capped-lethal branch does the opposite of what its neighbour documents as correct.
the_code.consequence: both branches exist to relax a MAGNITUDE that inherits an earlier roll. Only one of them keeps the attribution. So a lethal residual arrives with its source erased, the engine's renderer supplies the true source, and the comparison fails on attribution for a reason that has nothing to do with the roll it was relaxing.

19000191_63.showdown_line: |-damage|p1a: Raichu|0 fnt|[from] Leech Seed|[of] p2a: Tangela
19000191_63.note: Showdown SUPPLIES the attribution -- [from] Leech Seed is right there in the protocol -- and the parser throws it away because the mon fainted. The engine keeps it. 28 against 29 is a one-HP roll difference that the roll bucket would have absorbed.

19000147_125.note: the MIRROR case, and it is the one that proves the defect is the overwrite rather than a mere disagreement. Here the OBSERVED side kept `psn` and the ENGINE side is the one reading `capped_lethal` -- because the engine's branch is where the faint happens. Same mechanism, opposite sides, and the two labels can never meet.

the_fix.form: mirror the neighbour: `source = f"{source}_capped_lethal"`, and route the suffix the way `_to_full` is routed (`source.endswith("_to_full")` has an existing branch), so the magnitude is relaxed while the attribution is still compared.
the_fix.why_this_is_not_widening: it does not add tolerance. The magnitude relaxation is already there and is already justified by the comment. This RESTORES a comparison the parser was silently skipping -- it makes the matcher stricter on attribution while leaving the roll relaxation untouched. Closing rows by preserving information is the opposite of closing them by widening a rule.
the_fix.expected_scope: 2 rows measured here. Likely more: the overwrite fires on EVERY lethal residual, so any family containing one is affected -- reports/c99 records LS_capped_lethal_shape at 7 rows, whose name is this literal. That should be measured, not assumed; reports/c100 predicted 10 and measured -7.
the_fix.gate: needs a pin that fails when reverted, and a single-variable sweep reporting matched and skip alongside diverged.

how_this_was_found: reports/c103 re-adjudicated the limit:roll_divergent_lethality rows -- a re-adjudication filed by reports/c91 and reports/c89 and never run -- and found five of five were defects rather than limits, across two classes. Three were the already-caused faint-without-damage class. These two were the residue that nothing covered, and this is their cause. Neither would have been visible without running the re-adjudication.
and_it_explains_the_label: limit:roll_divergent_lethality has been absorbing these because the overwrite makes every lethal residual look like a roll-scaled component whose counterpart disagrees -- which is the exact shape of a roll dispute. The label was reporting the parser's own erasure back as a property of the comparison.

implementation_map.note: I started the implementation and stopped when it turned out to touch four sites plus a delicate existing path. Recording the map so the next attempt is turn-key rather than exploratory.
the_three_routing_sites_that_mirror__to_: :601 -- `if source in _ROLL_SCALED_SOURCES or source.endswith("_to_full")`. Must also accept `_capped_lethal` or the component leaves the roll bucket and the magnitude relaxation this branch exists for is lost.

:826-827 -- `capped = component.source.endswith("_to_full")` and the base-stripping beneath it. Needs the same suffix handling so attribution compares on the BASE source (psn against psn) rather than on the decorated string.

:884-885 -- the capped-heal bound gate, `if not obs_source.endswith("_to_full") and not _eng_source.endswith("_to_full")`. Decide deliberately whether a capped LETHAL takes the same bound as a capped HEAL.
implementation_map.the_delicate_part_and_why_i_stopped: the BARE `capped_lethal` source already has its own handling -- a one-sided `abs(obs) <= abs(eng) + 1` test, and the file's own comment at the capped-heal bound records that applying that one-sided form to capped heals WAS A DEFECT ('it rejected the motivating Rest case, 251 vs 247, while accepting a 24x-too-small 10 vs 247'). So the suffix change must not silently route lethal residuals into, or out of, that test by accident. Getting that wrong produces a plausible sweep number in either direction, which is the failure mode this programme keeps recording.
implementation_map.how_to_verify: single-variable sweep against main at 04e7784e (diverged 21, matched 15202, skip 1, lossy 11), reporting matched and skip alongside diverged, plus the closed/opened row identities. A pin that fails when reverted. Do NOT assume the scope: LS_capped_lethal_shape is 7 rows and is named for this literal, but reports/c100 predicted 10 and measured -7.
implementation_map.status: NOT IMPLEMENTED. The cause is established; the routing is mapped; the risk is concentrated in one adjacent path.
